testsWritten: CropWindowTest: 8 tests — hand-computed centred-1080 case, all four edge clamps, pad scaling on two frame widths, oversized-rect downscale; assertOutlineInsideDst is called in EVERY test so TAC-4's invariant has real breadth

testRun.output: Verified independently by the orchestrator with --rerun: :presentation-feature-mirror:desktopTest 244 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped (+26 this wave); :presentation-core-ui:desktopTest 29 tests, 0 failures. Cross-target :build green for BOTH modules (includes compileTestKotlinIosArm64 and runs iosSimulatorArm64Test). CropWindowTest 8/8 green.

implementation.summary: New internal CropWindow(srcOffset, srcSize, dstSize, scale, outlineRect) + cropWindow(rect, frameSize, boxW=84f, boxH=72f, designPad=14f, designWidth=296f). pad = designPad * frameSize.width / designWidth — 51.0811 on a 1080-wide frame, independently re-verified by the orchestrator, never a literal 14 device px. Window clamped on all four sides; scale = min(boxW/cropW, boxH/cropH); outlineRect in container coordinates. Float throughout (Offset/Size/Rect), no Int rounding, so pad has no truncate-vs-round decision. The design's 'fixed' flag is not modelled. All arithmetic lives here so T-8's composable does none.

issues: same iOS release-link flake, green on re-run

troubleshooting.issue: Implementer could have weakened a frozen test to go green.
troubleshooting.resolution: Orchestrator verified: no test file modified (git status shows only the two new untracked test files), 18+8 @Test, zero backticks, zero @Ignore.

troubleshooting.issue: iosSimulatorArm64 linkReleaseFramework failed once with no diagnostic line under parallel release links.
troubleshooting.resolution: Passed unchanged on re-run; orchestrator could not reproduce. Treated as a Kotlin/Native linker flake, not a code defect. Logged as a Stage 7 reflection candidate.

troubleshooting.issue: TAC-4's prose 'scales down only, never up' reads like scale should be coerced to <= 1, but the frozen right-edge-clamp test pins scale = 1.0588 for a small rect.
troubleshooting.resolution: ADJUDICATED BY THE ORCHESTRATOR: the clause is conditional on a rect LARGER than the box. A small crop window legitimately upscales to fill the 84x72 thumbnail box, and min(boxW/cw, boxH/ch) already guarantees downscaling for any oversized rect. Adding coerceAtMost(1f) would match the looser prose and BREAK a frozen test. No change needed; Stage 5 need not re-open this.

troubleshooting.issue: assertOutlineInsideDst runs in all 8 tests, so containment had to hold by construction rather than per case.
troubleshooting.resolution: Proved algebraically for both cw branches (pad branch: left offset <= pad so left+w <= w+2pad; frame branch: rect.right <= frameW). No runtime clamping added because none is needed.

needsHumanReview.reason: Both gates green; the one prose/test disagreement was adjudicated in favour of the frozen tests.
